title: Midwifery Health Tutor
qualification: Bachelor of Midwifery with a Postgraduate Qualification in Medical Education; or Diploma in Nursing with a Bachelor of Medical Education (BME).
summary: Arua School of Comprehensive Nursing is hiring 2 Midwifery Health Tutors to plan and deliver midwifery training, supervise clinical placements, and mentor student midwives.
description:
**Vacancy Announcement — Arua School of Comprehensive Nursing**

**Position: Midwifery Health Tutor (2 Posts)**

Arua School of Comprehensive Nursing, a leading health training institution in the West Nile region, trains quality nurses for quality services. We are seeking motivated Midwifery Health Tutors to join our academic team.

**Minimum Qualifications:**
- Bachelor of Midwifery with Postgraduate Qualification in Medical Education; **or**
- Diploma in Nursing with Bachelor of Medical Education (BME).

**Experience/Other Requirements:**
- Teaching experience in a health training institution is an added advantage.
- Registration with the Uganda Nurses and Midwives Council (UNMC) is desirable.

**Key Responsibilities:**
- Plan, prepare, and deliver lectures, demonstrations, and practical sessions in midwifery courses in line with the national curriculum.
- Develop lesson plans, schemes of work, teaching aids, and assessment tools (CATs, assignments, examinations).
- Supervise and assess students during classroom learning, skills laboratory sessions, and clinical placements.
- Conduct continuous assessment and final examinations in accordance with UNMEB/UNMC regulations.
- Guide and mentor students professionally and provide academic support to learners with difficulties.
- Participate in curriculum review, quality assurance, research, and institutional development activities.
- Maintain accurate academic records, student progress reports, and attendance registers.
- Collaborate with clinical sites, preceptors, and other tutors to ensure effective clinical instruction.
- Uphold professional ethics, confidentiality, and safeguarding standards at all times.

**What We Offer:**
- An opportunity to shape the next generation of midwives serving communities across Uganda.
- A supportive working environment in Arua, West Nile.
how_to_apply: Submit written applications with certified copies of academic transcripts and certificates, a valid practicing license (where applicable), a detailed CV, and contact details of three referees to: The Principal, Arua School of Comprehensive Nursing, P.O. Box 78, Arua, Uganda. Applications may also be emailed to aruanursesschool@yahoo.com.
